| # Limitations of flashing with BDS Flashing Tool from CODESYS IDE {#limitations-of-flashing-with-bds-flashing-tool-from-codesys-ide-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                            |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Current known limitations:

 

- If the ASW configures UDS CAN (CAN2 Channel) to a different baudrate than 250 kBaud, then the flashing feature will be available only if you:

1.turn off the ignition (T15, on pin K24)

2.Wait until RC/40 completely shuts down and writes the CAN UDS Configuration in NVM.

Afterwards, you can flash with the new CAN UDS Configuration.
